_comment: IMMACULATE MAGISTRATE PUMPS A CREATURE THE SAME PLAN CASTS (Elves claude-play sweep, 2026-11-26).
Turn 5, main 1: one Forest, Concordant Crossroads (haste), Immaculate Magistrate and three Llanowar Elves;
Joraga Warcaller in hand. Forest -> Warcaller (unkicked), then Magistrate's {T}: five +1/+1 counters on the
Warcaller (five Elves). Warcaller 6/6 haste + three Llanowars at 1/1 + 5 = 24 damage -> win on turn 5.
Verified DISCRIMINATING: before TapTargetPumpSamePlanTargets the activation's target list was read off
the battlefield before the plan's casts, so the Warcaller could not be targeted at any budget and this
board did not win (d5 b0: no win). The unit test in test_elves.cpp pins both apply worlds.
